integrity: Analytic proof is primary evidence; sympy/mpmath verification checks expressions and representative numerical cases only. Public claims are unreviewed by independent mathematicians.
scientific_limitations: Global centered interior noncollocation holds for all positive decay and noise levels; unique positive separation is established only in the high-noise regime. Known mean/covariance, two equal independent noise variances, fixed interval and fixed decay. The full text of one plausible Kriging article and an earlier OU sampling dissertation were not obtainable; priority beyond inspected materials is not certified.
title: Strict interior two-sensor design and a high-noise separation law for an Ornstein–Uhlenbeck path
